blocks.task_summary: Find x-coordinates of intersection points A and C of f(x)=cos x and g(x)=sin 2x on [0,π].
method_path: Use identity sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x
Cancel cos x (cos x ≠ 0) to get sin x = 1/2
Solve for x in [0,π] to obtain x = π/6 and 5π/6

evidence.basis: recognising cos x = 2 sin x cos x (M1); (cos x ≠ 0) so sin x = 1/2 OR one correct value (A1); x-coordinates π/6 and 5π/6 A1

blocks.task_summary: Find area of shaded region R between f(x)=cos x and g(x)=sin 2x from B(π/2,0) to C.
method_path: Set up integral ∫_{π/2}^{5π/6} (cos x - sin 2x) dx
Integrate: antiderivative sin x + (1/2) cos 2x (or equivalent)
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: Integrate cos x and sin 2x separately over the interval, then subtract the areas.

evidence.basis: attempt to integrate (cos x ± sin 2x) (M1); ∫ ... = ... A1 (award A1 for ±correct integration); attempt to substitute limits M1; area = 1/4 A1
METHOD 2: integrate cos x and sin 2x separately, A1 for correct integration; attempt to substitute limits M1; attempt to subtract integrals (M1); area = 1/4 A1
